products.name: SmartCache Pro
products.description:
### Overview

Intelligent caching layer that learns from user patterns to predictively load content. Reduces server load by 70% while improving user experience.

### Key Features

- ML-powered prediction engine
- Automatic cache invalidation
- Real-time performance monitoring
- Zero-configuration setup

### Technical Stack

- Redis, Machine Learning, Edge Computing

### Requirements

- Node.js 16+, Redis 6+, 2GB RAM
products.integrationRequirements:
### Integration

- Drop-in replacement for current cache
- Zero-configuration setup
- Customizable TTL strategies, Prediction algorithms, Storage backends

### Testimonial

"SmartCache transformed our user experience overnight." - CTO, TechStartup

2.3s → 1.2s page load

products.name: FlowBuilder Studio
products.description:
### Overview

Drag-and-drop workflow automation that integrates with your existing tools. Build complex automations without code.

### Key Features

- 200+ pre-built connectors
- Visual debugging tools
- Version control built-in
- Team collaboration features

### Technical Stack

- TypeScript, React, Node.js

### Requirements

- Modern browser, API access
products.integrationRequirements:
### Integration

- API-first, works with any system
- Customizable: Custom nodes, Themes, Workflows

### Setup Time

- Embedded demo available

products.name: DataPulse Analytics
products.description:
### Overview

Stream processing pipeline that turns raw data into actionable insights. See what's happening in your business right now.

### Key Features

- Sub-second data processing
- Customizable dashboards
- Anomaly detection
- Predictive analytics

### Technical Stack

- Apache Kafka, ClickHouse, React

### Requirements

- Data source access, 8GB RAM
products.integrationRequirements:
### Integration

- Connects to existing data sources
- Customizable: Metrics, Alerts, Visualizations

### Demo

- Video duration: 2:30
